text_en: These are the names of the sons of Israel who came to Egypt with Jacob, each with his household:
text_cn: 以色列的儿子们，各带了家眷，同雅各伯来到埃及；他们的名字记载如下：

text_en: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
text_cn: 勒乌本、西默盎、肋未和犹大，

text_en: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
text_cn: 依撒加尔，则步隆和本雅明，

text_en: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
text_cn: 丹和纳斐塔里，加得和阿协尔。

text_en: The total number of people born to Jacob was seventy. Joseph was already in Egypt.
text_cn: 他们全是雅各伯所生的，一共七十人；若瑟那时已经在埃及。

text_en: Then Joseph died, and all his brothers, and that whole generation.
text_cn: 若瑟和他的众兄弟，以及这一代人死了以后，

text_en: But the Israelites were fruitful and prolific; they multiplied and grew exceedingly strong, so that the land was filled with them.
text_cn: 以色列的子孙生育繁殖，数目增多，极其强盛，布满了那地。

text_en: Now a new king arose over Egypt, who did not know Joseph.
text_cn: 有位不认识若瑟的新王兴起，统治了埃及。

text_en: He said to his people, “Look, the Israelite people are more numerous and more powerful than we.
text_cn: 他对自己的人民说：“看，以色列子民，比我们又多又强。

text_en: Come, let us deal shrewdly with them, or they will increase and, in the event of war, join our enemies and fight against us and escape from the land. ”
text_cn: 来，我们要用智谋对付他们，免得他们繁盛起来，一遇战争，就去与我们的敌人联合，攻击我们，然后离开此地。”

text_en: Therefore they set taskmasters over them to oppress them with forced labor. They built supply cities, Pithom and Rameses, for Pharaoh.
text_cn: 于是派定督工管制他们，以苦役压迫他们，叫他们给法郎建筑丕通和辣默色斯两座贮货城。

text_en: But the more they were oppressed, the more they multiplied and spread, so that the Egyptians came to dread the Israelites.
text_cn: 但是越压迫他们，他们越增多，也越繁殖，以至埃及人都怕以色列子民。

text_en: The Egyptians became ruthless in imposing tasks on the Israelites,
text_cn: 于是埃及人更严厉地强迫以色列子民做苦工，

text_en: and made their lives bitter with hard service in mortar and brick and in every kind of field labor. They were ruthless in all the tasks that they imposed on them.
text_cn: 强迫他们作和泥做砖的苦工，田间的一切劳工，以及种种苦工，使他们的生活十分痛苦。

text_en: The king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives, one of whom was named Shiphrah and the other Puah,
text_cn: 埃及王又吩咐为希伯来女人接生的收生婆，一个名叫史斐辣，一个名叫普亚的说：

text_en: “When you act as midwives to the Hebrew women, and see them on the birthstool, if it is a boy, kill him; but if it is a girl, she shall live. ”
text_cn: “你们为希伯来女人接生时，要看着她们临盆！若是男孩，就杀死；若是女孩，就让她活着。”

text_en: But the midwives feared God; they did not do as the king of Egypt commanded them, but they let the boys live.
text_cn: 但是收生婆敬畏天主，没有照埃及王的吩咐去作，保留了男孩的性命。

text_en: So the king of Egypt summoned the midwives and said to them, “Why have you done this, and allowed the boys to live? ”
text_cn: 埃及王将收生婆召来，问她们说：“你们为什么这样做，竟叫男孩子活着呢？”

text_en: The midwives said to Pharaoh, “Because the Hebrew women are not like the Egyptian women; for they are vigorous and give birth before the midwife comes to them. ”
text_cn: 收生婆回答法郎说：“希伯来女人与埃及女人不同，她们富有生机，收生婆还没有来，她们已生产了。”

text_en: So God dealt well with the midwives; and the people multiplied and became very strong.
text_cn: 天主遂恩待了收生婆。以色列子民更加增多起来，更加强盛。

text_en: And because the midwives feared God, he gave them families.
text_cn: 因为收生婆敬畏天主，天主就使她们家门兴旺。

text_en: Then Pharaoh commanded all his people, “Every boy that is born to the Hebrews you shall throw into the Nile, but you shall let every girl live. ”
text_cn: 法郎于是训令他的全体人民说：“凡希伯来人所生的男孩，你们应把他丢在尼罗河里；凡是女孩，留她活着！”
